sources.title: After being pushed out of Google, Timnit Gebru forms her own AI research institute DAIR

profile_text.body:
The Distributed AI Research Institute, which goes by DAIR, is a nonprofit founded in 2021 and headquartered in Oakland, California. Its own site describes it as a globally distributed organization of academics, activists, and engineers conducting community-rooted research, and as an independent organization. The site states that the group believes in technology that benefits everyone, that AI is seldom the solution and its advance should not be treated as inevitable, and that it provides guidelines and frameworks to researchers and practitioners seeking to build and deploy AI systems without theft and exploitation. The site also notes reflections from Kat, Nyalleng, and Raesetje from Deep Learning Indaba 2026, an annual gathering in Lagos focused on building Africa's AI future.

The institute was announced in its own press release, and TechCrunch reported its formation after Timnit Gebru was pushed out of Google. No products, MCP servers, or lawsuits are recorded for the organization. Its recorded legal exposure is in California, with a count of 281.
